sources.snippet: AI Humanizer Overview AI Humanizer is a free, open-source tool that transforms AI-generated text into language that reads naturally and authentically. Powered by Google Gemini 2.5 and guided by custom prompt engineering, it refines robotic or overly structured outputs into text with improved tone, rhythm, and clarity.

sources.title: AI Humanizer
sources.snippet: AI writing tools like ChatGPT, Gemini, and Claude are more popular than ever. However, their text can sound robotic and technical. The Originality.ai Free AI Humanizer rewrites AI text and turns it into human-like writing that is undetectable and bypasses many AI detectors — it will still be detectable by the best-in-class Originality.ai AI Checker.
